reviews.title: Keep my 5900x nice and chilly, plus the stock fans are pretty solid!
reviews.comment:
I picked this cooler up for $53 on sale, but even then; it's hard to beat for $60ish USD. I'm sincerely hoping ID never discontinues this line of cooler.
Installation on AM4 was a breeze, but I knew what to expect already since I'd been using ID's old Auraflow line in both customer and personal machines, and the quality was always historically solid for what you paid. The FX360 isn't an exception to the price-to-performance that I expect from ID. These guys make absolute powerhouse coolers for the price bracket, coming in even cheaper than some other complete no-name Temu brands lol.
Cooling on this is no doubt stellar. In the second pic, you'll see a series of numbers in my task bar. The first set of numbers is my CPU overall usage, and the second set is CPU package temp. With an ambient temp of 17° C / 64° F, my 5900x idles at a mere 29° C which is just nuts for how inexpensive this cooler is.
As far as stock fans go, I love them. The daisy chain system is a welcome sight that should be common now that we're firmly in an era of daisy chain innovation (thanks Lian Li), but I also love how short the fan cables are. I was running Antec Storm T3 fans on this cooler at first, but I hated how long the fan cables were, and I had two of them die within 6 months. After I swapped back to the stock ID fans, I was reminded just how well these budget-class fans perform. I keep mine at a steady 1200rpm, and while I can hear them, they're not super loud; and they move plenty of air.
Please ID, if you see this: Never discontinue the FX line. You knocked it out of the park.
reviews.author: Logan Campbell

reviews.title: Works great and is low key
reviews.comment:
While I do not mind a little RGB, I wanted something that was a bit more low-key with this, while providing excellent cooling. I had just purchased an AMD 9800x3D, so wanted to protect my investment. This had great reviews both here and on 3rd party sites and the price was solid.
I have not been disappointed. It was easy to install with good instructions. It is well-made and has a solid feel to it. As far as what is actually important, it functions great, keeping my CPU cool even while under heavy load. Even when I did stress testing, I could not get my CPU over 80c and most of the time, under load, it stays around 60c. Idling, it stays around 32c in a fairly warm room. Depending on your style, this may or may not fit what you want in the looks department. For me I love the look of it. While it may not be flashy, it has a sleek elegant look to it.
reviews.author: Clintre

reviews.title: Its a very good aio.
reviews.comment: You know this aio looks great and it surprisingly performs excellent.  It kept my 265k ultra cool around 30 degrees Celsius and when I'm gaming it was around 67 degrees.  The pump is strong and very quite.  The fan are very good and move alot of air.  For the price it is a excellent buy.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Excellent value, looks and performance!!
reviews.comment: Great value and has no RGB which is what I wanted. Looks great in my mATX build and keeps my 9800X3D at 39C at idle. Appreciate the fans being pre-assembled on the radiator too, made install super easy. Used the included Frost FX45 thermal grease as well. The FX45 thermal grease is kinda thick so I used pea dot application method and it works as stated above.
reviews.author: TangledThorns
